title: 1. Qualify the frozen negative warp with one 90-pair instrument
hypothesis: The frozen negative phase warp improves sustained spinning by redistributing contact dwell within each roll cycle without increasing stroke energy or drops.

prediction.rationale: D-062 motivates a prospective gain prediction; qualification still requires the standing paired-t lower bound above zero, not merely a positive point estimate.

protocol.command: gpu run 'bash -lc "source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --study r089_warp_qualification_90 --log-dir logs/pen_spin/r089_warp_qualification_90"'
code_changes: The 90-pair instrument (lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/clamp_qualification.py) generalised to take parent and candidate from its config block; registered as --study r089_warp_qualification_90 in scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py; settings in config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml. Parent: the D-058 incumbent asset (hashes checked). Candidate: the exact D-062 epsilon -0.35 warp, resolved from the archived run's phase_warp_source.py and constants.json, both hash-checked; the study aborts if either is missing or differs, never reconstructs it.

Three frozen 40-case Stage-3 manifests (seeds 4700, 4701, 4702; cases 0-9 unused, cases 10-39 the panel), placement-disjoint from every committed pen-spin manifest and from each other. Offline identity gate (epsilon 0 bit for bit on D-050's archived observations) rerun before any episode. Parent and candidate each run each panel in its own fresh process: six processes, 180 episodes, zero LLM calls.

One-off instrument of the existing strict rule: one paired t interval at the existing confidence level over the 90 prospectively declared differences; qualification requires a positive mean and a lower bound strictly above zero; adoption additionally requires candidate drops not exceeding the parent's over the 90 pairs. No interim decision, historical pooling, extension or retry.

Prediction: candidate minus parent pooled over the 90 pairs at least +0.05; refuted if the upper bound is below +0.05; a zero-inclusive interval is inconclusive and does not qualify. Reported: sustained success, paired wins/losses/ties, drops, failure split, in-play mean |spin|, drive and per-axis executed-action saturation, overall and per panel; qualification.json for the conditional R-090. Held-out split untouched.

falsified_by: A paired interval upper bound below +0.05 refutes the predicted magnitude. An interval including zero is inconclusive and does not qualify the warp; more observed drops blocks adoption.
